title: MEN1: gene, 3P majors and minor tumours
guide: MEN types 1, 2A, 2B/3, 4. MEN1 AD, M=F, MENIN (tumour suppressor, 11q), intron inversion > base-pair deletion. Major <20 yrs 3P: parathyroid 100%, pancreas 50–70%, pituitary 30–50%. Minor skin angiofibroma > collagenoma > lipoma; benign adreno-cortical adenoma (m/c), meningioma (m/c neuro), pheo <1%; malignant PNET, thymic & foregut carcinoid.

title: MEN1 organ-by-organ and the MEN2A gene
guide: 1° HPT: MEN1 asymmetric hyperplasia <20 yrs M=F vs sporadic adenoma F>40 (peak 60); IOC 99mTc sestamibi; Rx 3½ near-total parathyroidectomy. m/c hypercalcaemia symptom = fatigue. Pancreas: enteropancreatic NET = m/c cause of death; gastrinoma > insulinoma > glucagonoma (migratory necrolytic erythematous rash) > VIPoma (WDHA, NAGMA). Gastrinoma MEN1: duodenum, small multifocal, <5%, endoscopic US, lymph; sporadic: Passaro's, large, >50–60%, SRS, blood; >2 cm surgery; streptozocin+octreotide vs high-dose PPI. Pituitary prolactinoma aggressive macro. MEN2A = RET (10q, point mutation).

title: MEN2A variants, MEN2B/MEN3 and MEN4
guide: Classical MEN2A: MTC 100% + pheo 50% + parathyroid hyperplasia 25%; variants + cutaneous lichen amyloidosis, + Hirschsprung's, FMTC. MEN2B/3: MTC 100% + pheo 50% + marfanoid habitus, mucosal & intestinal ganglioneuromatosis (tongue photo), myelinated corneal nerves. MEN4 = CDKN1B: parathyroid + pituitary + renal/adrenal + testicular/ovarian tumours.

title: Syndrome gene table and Carney's triad
guide: HPT-jaw tumour (parafibromin/CDC73; ossifying jaw fibroma; parathyroid Ca), Carney's complex (PRKAR1A; atrial myxoma lepidic; PPNAD thin Cushing's, GH adenoma; lentigenes), VHL (Chr3; RCC, cerebellar haemangioblastoma, islet tumours, papillary cystadenoma broad ligament, epididymal cyst, endolymphatic sac; pheo; pancreatic cysts), NF1 (Chr17; optic sheath > meningioma; pheo U/L), Cowden (PTEN; breast Ca, hamartomatous polyps; nodular goitre/Hashimoto's), McCune-Albright (not inherited, post-zygotic GNAS; PFD, precocious puberty, café-au-lait). Carney's triad = pulmonary chondroma + GIST + paraganglioma.

title: RCC comparisons, Cushing's by age and the APS 1/2 table
guide: VHL RCC B/L young lymphatic vs sporadic U/L elderly blood-stream. TS: kidney cysts + angiomyolipoma vs VHL pancreatic cysts (m/c) + RCC. Cushing's m/c cause: adults pituitary adenoma; infants McCune-Albright; toddlers adrenocortical carcinoma. PGA = APS: type 1 childhood M=F AR, APECED/AIRE, anti-21-hydroxylase + anti-interferon, skin/nail +, Graves > Hashimoto's + hypoparathyroidism + Addison's, candidiasis; type 2 adult F>M polygenic HLA DR3/DR4, Hashimoto's > Graves + Addison's, coeliac association; minor both type 1 DM + hypogonadism.
